findings: Identity audit currently covers 718 source-bound entries across the core games and all eight supplied Rifts books, including Aliens Unlimited racial groups, named branches, generation/shared rules and monster identities. This remains a partial corpus audit, not numerical or release acceptance.
Remaining core child paths, supplement subpaths, supporting mechanical entries throughout the supplied books remain to be audited. Identity evidence does not certify numerical rules.

All 718 canonical identities now have a named ticket owner under 02B11; supporting-entry audit, mechanical/dependency acceptance and automation remain pending. The existing Vagabond ticket covers only part of its required mechanics.

Mercenary NPC profiles include referenced Uteni, Dysasha, Raksasha, Brodkil, tattooed/witch/psionic paths and Dog Pack Wolf examples. Profile-to-existing-option reconciliation and full racial/template evidence remain pending; named personnel are not invented independent O.C.C.s.

Remaining South America 2 occupation adaptations, heritage variants and referenced magic/augmentation systems need full dependency review; named ticket ownership is assigned under 02B11. Destroyer Borg remains blocked by the verified damaged page.

Powers Unlimited 2 category and named creation-branch identities are audited. Its genetic options, mental disciplines, weapon specialties, powers and other supporting mechanics still need complete dependency review; named ticket ownership is assigned under 02B11; remaining Heroes supporting rules stay pending.

Aliens Unlimited amphibian, aquatic, ape, avian, canine and feline identities are confirmed against original body headings and footers (PDF = printed +1). Darkith and Wardions retain parent relationships; generation systems, supporting mechanics and named content-ticket ownership is assigned under 02B11; mechanics and dependencies remain pending.

Aliens Unlimited Humanoid/Insect/Mineral/Reptile/Vegetation identities, embedded caste/training/augmentation branches and shared mineral/plant/generation rules are source-bound. Galactic monster mechanics, full source count reconciliation, remaining supporting entries and mechanics/dependencies remain pending; named ticket ownership is assigned under 02B11.

Galactic Monsters & Evil source guidance defaults to NPC use except explicit player options. Dark Breeze organization is distinct from its monster namesake; Dopplegangers is a shared family. The book introduction names 84 races, while the audited body has 85 ordinary profiles plus named variants/castes and monster entries; reconcile that source count before closing complete coverage. Other Heroes supporting rules and all numerical dependencies remain pending.

Aliens race-count evidence is explicit: original introduction printed 8/PDF 9 says 84, alphabetical index printed 191/PDF 192 lists 85 primary profiles, and optional Tables A/B printed 18-19/PDF 19-20 have 84 rows with Atorians omitted and Mantis instead of indexed Manteze. No source-confirmed counting convention resolves this; keep both evidence and discrepancies pending rather than force the catalog count.

Powers Unlimited 1 adds 125 Minor, 45 Major and 21 body-listed psionic power identities plus three source section groups. No new OCC/RCC/race/construction path is claimed. Quick Find aliases, further prose/sub-power variants, complete dependencies, numerical acceptance and remaining supporting-entry review remain pending; named ticket ownership is assigned under 02B11. The introductory nearly-200 claim is not a complete mechanical coverage certification.

Powers Unlimited 3 adds 124 named independent powers, ten new Animal Abilities variants, their extension family and two source section groups. Counting the ten variants rather than the extension header yields 134 abilities, a plausible but not explicit foreword count convention. Missing printed 60–61 blocks Energy Conversion, Energy Wings and the opening of Enlarge Items under 02C3. The scan also has a wide spread/repeated-page transition at physical PDF 87–88; original body locators use exact page evidence rather than one global offset. Reprint aliases, full shared dependencies, numerical acceptance and remaining supporting-entry review remain pending; named ticket ownership is assigned under 02B11.

Mercenaries original printed page 40 is absent and printed 41 is repeated; transition guidance stays unaccepted under 02C4. Merc Ops physical PDF 73 contains printed 72 and 73 as a spread, so later printed 74 onward use matching PDF numbers. Existing Auto-G and Mercenary class identity locators are unaffected. The original books remain unchanged; source gaps are fingerprint-bound overlays.
